Create only a flat, straight-on A4 portrait sheet of warm ivory paper, edge-to-edge paper, no desk, no device, no app interface, no perspective or drop shadow.
Editorial style: a thoughtful artist's field journal, fine graphite and sepia ink, loose watercolor in muted sage, olive and ochre, airy composition with generous blank paper. One large graceful botanical study of an olive branch crossing the central-right portion, two small leaf studies and a tiny landscape sketch in the lower-left. Natural imperfect hand lettering with just these short readable words: "Small discoveries", "a walk, a leaf, a little light", "olive / afternoon sun". One subtle hand-drawn ochre underline and a couple of small arrows connecting observations. Very restrained, literate, quietly beautiful; a plausible page made with a stylus, without photographic realism. No typeset body paragraphs, no extra text, no clip art collage, no borders, no watermark. Let the page breathe.
